name: Cultist: Void-Enchanted Armor resists dispel instead of weakening it (#787)
contract: Spell 804633: "Increases your chance to resist dispel effects by 20%." It is a passive (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE) with a single effect: Apply Aura (6), AuraName 235 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DISPEL_RESIST), TargetA 1 (self). Aura::CalcDispelChance (SpellAuras.cpp:1152-1158) sums SPELL_AURA_MOD_DISPEL_RESIST straight into resistChance before returning `100 - resistChance`, so a positive amount must raise dispel resistance. The shipped Spell.dbc row carries EffectBasePoints_1 = -21, DieSides_1 = 1; SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:468-496) adds 1 for DieSides=1, giving -20 (a table scan of every Spell.dbc row using this aura type, 21 total, found only two other negative rows: 525063, unrelated, and 706650, already explicitly guarded in CalcDispelChance by caster class). This asserts the live aura_amount, the exact value the native formula consumes; a fixed spell_dbc row keeps every other field and sets EffectBasePoints_1 = 19 so CalcValue yields +20.

steps.label: Void-Enchanted Armor is a passive and auto-applies on learn
The stored amount must be +20 (dispel resistance), not -20 (dispel weakness)
